thread:
anya: Quick sync — I sketched an "orchestration gap map" for the ACME private onramp. Need alignment across runtime/infra/security before we lock the launch criteria. TL;DR: pockets of risk around KMS gating + burst capacity.
james: pinging in. can you paste the sketch? want to see sequenced deps.
anya: pasted below. it's high level: \n- product: launch criteria (SLA, privacy signoff, rollback)\n- runtime: adaptive routing + fallback model variant\n- infra: reserved capacity slots + prewarm windows\n- security: KMS/HSM integration + audit/event retention
Need owners & earliest unblock dates.
matt: looks right. customer is pushing for end of May. realistic?
li: infra reality: reserved GPU pool can be available mid-May if we commit today. autoscale burst needs an infra change (slot preemption guard) that is ~3w of work and ops testing.
james: runtime note — fallback model variant requires a quantized 4-bit build and integration of model-compat routing. that's somewhere between 2–4 weeks depending on tensorRT/ops. also need KV cache warmup for canary.
tess: security: KMS integration is on our radar. HSM path adds compliance but adds 1 sprint for testing + SOC checklist. if we accept customer managed KMS (bring-your-own), we shorten it to 1 week of onboarding + docs.
anya: decision point: do we require HSM for initial pilot? customer is okay with BYOK for pilot but enterprise customers later will require HSM.
matt: suggest BYOK for pilot, HSM gated for GA. that buys schedule slack.
james: ok for runtime: plan A (pilot) = quantized build + routing + lightweight fallback (different model instance) — 2w. Plan B (GA w/HSM) we'll schedule after infra/security clear.
li: infra action items:\n- reserve pool: owner li, ETA 2026-05-10\n- slot preemption guard: owner li, ETA 2026-05-24\n- prewarm window config: owner infra-sre (cc @deploy-bot), ETA 2026-05-12
tess: security action items:\n- BYOK onboarding doc: owner tess, ETA 2026-04-25\n- HSM integration plan: owner tess, ETA 2026-06-07\n- audit retention policy update: owner tess, ETA 2026-05-05
anya: product items:\n- launch criteria doc (SLA, rollback, success metrics): owner anya, ETA 2026-04-20\n- customer acceptance checklist: owner matt, ETA 2026-04-22
james: runtime tasks:\n```
- quantized 4-bit build: owner james, ETA 2026-04-28
- routing policy + fallback wiring: owner james, ETA 2026-05-03
- canary KV warmup script: owner runtime-sig, ETA 2026-05-08
```
anya: quick ask — can infra and runtime confirm a canary path that doesn't touch HSM for pilot? that's the BYOK flow.
li: yes — BYOK path bypasses HSM. infra will expose a BYOK auth token vault endpoint. important: need strict RBAC for token creation.
tess: BYOK still needs audit hooks. I'll add a lightweight audit forwarder to ensure events land in the compliance log; ETA 2026-04-30.
matt: happy with sequence. suggest we gate customer kickoff until product doc is done and reserve pool exists. otherwise we'll risk throttled requests.
anya: agree. proposed gating rule: kickoff allowed when (1) reserve pool exists OR autoscale guard merged, (2) BYOK onboarding complete, (3) runtime quantized build passes smoke tests.
james: can we make a soft fallback: if reserve pool isn't ready, route to hosted capacity with rate limit 10qps to keep SLA? we should define cost acceptance.
li: hosted fallback doable. infra will add routing tag to requests so billing/cost is tracked. need product approval for cost exposure.
anya: product approves limited hosted fallback for pilot with cost cap $2k/week. put in the doc.
matt: I'll add a section to acceptance checklist about cost cap and fallback behavior.
deploy-bot: deploy candidate #acme-onramp-quantized to staging started by james at 2026-04-15T09:12Z :rocket:
james: staging run healthy so far. KV warmup takes ~18s for 2k unique prefixes.
tess: note: ensure we redact any KMS tokens from logs. I'll run a log-scan preflight.
li: infra will create a "preflight checklist" ticket and ping all owners when ready. ETA for ticket: 2026-04-16.
anya: excellent. next steps summary (short):\n- li: reserve pool + preempt guard\n- james: quantized build + routing + canary script\n- tess: BYOK docs + audit forwarder + log-scan\n- anya/matt: launch criteria + acceptance checklist + cost cap\nLet's reconvene 2026-04-18 10:00 for a 20m sync if preflight ticket exists. If not, push to 04-20. :calendar:
matt: noted. I'll update the acceptance checklist with fallback flow and cost cap by EOD.
james: I'll drop a short runbook for runtime fallback in the thread by tomorrow.
li: creating infra ticket now and will tag everyone.
anya: thanks all — this kept it tight. I'll start the launch criteria doc and link it here (will post URL). :thumbsup:
